app.title: WikiSignals
app.tagline: Community health and capacity analytics for Wikimedia

common.disclaimerCompare: Raw counts do not make one community better than another.

health.title: Community health signals
health.intro: Interpretable operational signals — not a single health score. Each signal has a transparent rule and drill-down.
health.vsWikistats: Wikistats measures how much activity is happening. This observatory focuses on the pressures that activity creates: maintenance backlog, admin workload, process queues, conflict signals, and automation dependence.
health.contextIntro: These series are consumed from Wikimedia Analytics (Wikistats family) as denominators and context — not the product focus.

domains.capacityIntro: Active editor capacity from official analytics, used as denominators for workload ratios.
domains.maintenanceIntro: Configured maintenance queues and backlog per active editor. Categories are project configuration — never hard-coded language assumptions.
domains.governanceIntro: Local process queues (deletion discussions, noticeboards, etc.) when configured for this project.
domains.adminIntro: Aggregate administrative log activity. Workload distribution, not administrator rankings.
domains.conflictIntro: Revert and conflict signals at system level. High rates need interpretation — they are not diagnoses.
domains.automationIntro: Bot edit share and related automation dependence. Co-trends with backlog are not automatic causation.

context.title: Official activity context
context.intro: Authoritative activity statistics from Wikimedia Analytics / Wikistats-compatible APIs. Shown for context and as denominators. This page is not the primary purpose of the Community Health Observatory.

compare.title: Cross-project comparison
compare.intro: Compare signals carefully. Policies, bots, and workflows differ — raw counts are not rankings.

history.title: Historical trends
history.intro: Long-period exploration with manually supplied community event annotations. Causality is not inferred automatically.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: Every signal has a canonical ID, definition, formula, source, and caveats. Official metrics preserve provenance.

privacy.title: Privacy & ethics
privacy.body: This product analyzes public Wikimedia contribution data in aggregate form. It must not become a volunteer-surveillance platform. We do not build individual ranking systems, admin scoreboards, or demographic inference.

funnel.title: New editor funnel (deprecated here)
funnel.intro: Detailed newcomer analytics belong to the New Editor Health Dashboard. This page remains only for compatibility.
funnel.requiresReplicas: Use the dedicated New Editor Health product for cohort analysis.
